description: Generate approval_evidence_bundler.py: pure function compute_evidence_bundle(server_id) that queries write_service for all signal scores (7 dimensions + injection_resilience), attestation text, pi_scorer results, corpus hash, and analyst decision metadata from mcp_decisions. Bundles into signed JSON dict with fields: server_id, mcp_name, verdict_tier, composite_score, signal_scores (dict by signal_name), pi_injection_resilience (if present), attestation_text, corpus_hash, decision_by, decided_at, conditions_list. No DB writes. Returns (bundle_dict, evidence_dict) tuple. Called by approval_workflow.py after decision is logged.
